title: CHANGE_TRUST fails with CHANGE_TRUST_NOT_AUTH_MAINTAIN_LIABILITIES
pattern: A transaction whose CHANGE_TRUST operation fails at apply is still written into the closed ledger: its fee is charged, its sequence number is consumed, and nothing it did is kept. The result carries the operation's code (not_auth_maintain_liabilities). A pool-share trustline for XLM/ARQ while the ARQ trustline is not even authorized to maintain liabilities.

hazards.placement: pool-share trustline over an unauthorized asset trustline
ARQ trustline not authorized to maintain liabilities

facts.says: No operation changed state: the operation meta is empty.
The fee is still charged: the fee source changes in fee processing.
